2. Run `python -m pytest -q` to identify the failing tests.
3. Identify the first failing test and read the corresponding test function in `test_convert.py`.
4. Read the implementation of the function in `convert.py` that is being tested.
5. Attempt to fix the function body in `convert.py` to pass the failing test. If the fix is a single line, use `edit_file` with the exact line. If the fix involves multiple lines or is ambiguous, use `write_file` with the entire corrected function.
6. Run `python -m pytest -q` again to check if the test is now passing.
7. If the test is still failing, repeat steps 3-6, focusing on the next failing test and the corresponding function in `convert.py`.
8. Continue this process until all tests pass, ensuring that the EXACT signatures of the functions in `convert.py` are maintained.
